operation_preflight: Reject unresolved draw operations before Vulkan submission.
Reject Copy/Convert operations missing source or destination extent/base/pitch.
Require complete, unique, ordered draw references and strictly increasing packet ordinals.
changes.texture_descriptor: Prepared Vulkan textures now retain their guest address, format, endian, pitch, tiled, and packed-mip descriptor fields for a future ordered-copy resource lookup. No copy result is currently substituted for guest RAM texture bytes.
changes.interrupt_trace: With ring tracing enabled, each PM4_INTERRUPT record includes generation, batch read/write pointers, ring guest address, expanded packet ordinal, source IB and byte offset, requested/dispatched CPU masks, and per-asserted-CPU callback guest address, callback data, and dispatch status.

verification.native_linux_ctest: 4/4 passed; renderer operation-stream failure cases ran through the available Vulkan validation layer.
verification.linux_plugin_compile: Clang compiled the plugin and live-ring smoke translation units using the isolated task build directory; no SDK libraries were rebuilt or relinked.
verification.android_device: Redmi Note 8 Pro is visible to ADB at 192.168.1.32:38615. No plugin was installed and no game process was restarted.

not_implemented: No ordered Vulkan render/copy execution has been added for the 14-operation transition package.
No persistent aliased Xenos EDRAM color or depth/stencil backing exists.
The format-12 4x to format-26 resolve and seven format-31 writes remain unsupported.
No current-device PM4_INTERRUPT callback-address trace was collected; the running phone plugin predates this instrumentation.
No trace has been sent to Process 1 because there is not yet a fresh live trace to share.
limits: These changes improve operation validation and trace observability. They do not establish rendered parity, video-transition success, guest synchronization correctness, or Android renderer readiness.
